{{Quote|Hutch is gone. He was my friend. He piloted me once to a mission in the Belassar system.|Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="Journal">''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]''</ref>}}
The '''Belassar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sarla sector/Legends|Sarla sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Online Companion" /> Early during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[mission in the Belassar system]] between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]&ndash;[[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the first two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].</ref> prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] moved to suppress [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] activity in the system. In response, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Consular ship/Legends|consular ship]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> accompanied by [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon "Dutch" Vander]],<ref name="Journal" /> [[Mission in the Belassar system|arrived]] to clandestinely support the Rebels.<ref name="Atlas" /> From at least [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] to [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], the Bellasar system fell within the borders of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&ndash;controlled [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Belassar system was first mentioned in the [[1998]] young-readers story ''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]'', written by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="Journal" />

The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Belassar system in grid square J-8 and expanded on Leia Organa's mission there,<ref name="Atlas" /> as first recounted in Watson's story.<ref name="Journal" />
